t: You're at Primrose Hill, a Grade II listed public park just north of Regent's Park. It opened to the public in 1842 and takes its name from the hill at its centre, which rises sixty-four metres and is one of the highest points in Camden. Quite a few well-known people have lived around here, among them the actors Daniel Craig, Daisy Ridley and Stephen Mangan, and the economist Noreena Hertz. The botanist Agnes Arber, the first woman botanist elected a Fellow of the Royal Society, was born here.
